sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Permeshwar Dutt Tewari,Alok Kumar Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No.0158 of 2023, under Sections 120-B, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 409 I.P.C., registered at Police Station-Gomti Nagar Extension, District-Lucknow.

2. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a F.I.R. lodged on 17.06.2023 by the District Commandant Home Guards, Lucknow against fourteen persons, including the Block Organizer (Company Commander)-Suresh Singh and several other Home Guards, including the applicant, alleging that the Block Organizer Home Guards-Suresh Singh used to certify attendance of Home Guards on Muster Roll and obtain payments in illegal manner, without actual performance of duties.
The F.I.R. states that the Home Guards may be involved in commission of the offence with Block Officer-Suresh Singh.
3. The applicant was issued a show cause notice on 19.06.2023 and he has submitted his reply dated Manish Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ...

1 24.06.2023 to the District Commandant, a copy whereof is annexed with the affidavit filed in support of this application, stating that he had been assigned duty at only one place and he performed the assigned duty.

He had informed to his B.O. about the excess amount being credited in his bank account in addition to the duty allowance payable to him and the co-accused Suresh Singh had directed the applicant to transfer the amount in an Account told by him and, accordingly,
the applicant transferred the amount to the account told by Suresh Singh.
The applicant stated that the applicant has not received any amount illegally and he has not committed any offence and that he acted as per instructions of Suresh Singh.

4. Co-accused Narendra Kumar has been granted anticipatory bail by means of the order dated 06.09.2023 passed in CRIMINAL MISC ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION U/S 438 CR.P.C.
No. - 1958 of 2023.
5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the F.I.R. principally contains allegations against Suresh Singh and allegation against the Home Guards is only of a suspicion of their involvement with Suresh Singh; that the applicant has promptly transferred the amount that was wrongly credited to his account and that the applicant has no previous criminal antecedents.
I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be granted anticipatory bail.
7. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
